intro: Government, telecommunications, and civil-society entities were the primary targets in a recent cluster of surveillance-related incidents, with the United States, Iran, and Mexico most affected. The period from April 12 to April 23, 2026, saw seven articles covering a severity mix of two medium, three informational, one critical, and one high. The critical vulnerability CVE-2026-22898, carrying a CVSS score of 8.8, was a key concern.
